translations.web: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”
translations.bsb: Then the woman said, “Please, may your servant speak a word to my lord the king?” “Speak,” he replied.
translations.kjv: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
translations.asv: Then the woman said, Let thy handmaid, I pray thee, speak a word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
